csv_project_name: Consultant for ADA Transition Plan Update - Salinas
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Salinas Public Works Department is soliciting proposals from qualified professional firms to develop and implement a comprehensive Self-Evaluation of the City s Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Transition Plan (the Plan ) for City programs, facilities, and infrastructure, and to update the Plan. This Request for Proposals (RFP) seeks to secure the most qualified consultant to evaluate City policies and programs, perform field investigations within the City right-of-way and of City facilities, and to update the ADA Transition Plan identifying current obstacles limiting accessibility, providing recommendations to improve accessibility, and include a schedule for achieving ADA compliance.
